cover: Make a completely NEW original 16:9 videogame title key art based on the attached low-poly music-video frame's art direction. This must look like a rough 2000s LOW-POLY BLENDER STREET SCENE / flat-material PS1 render, not a clean vector anime superhero poster. Black and white Hong Kong apartment blocks, irregular chunky windows, flat faceted surfaces, crooked slightly Dutch-angle perspective and overhead cables, hot MAGENTA sky. Left 42 percent mostly black quiet building shadow for a separate game menu. Right 58 percent shows ONLY TWO WAIST-UP ANONYMOUS STREETWEAR FIGURES. Both casually walking with HANDS IN JACKET POCKETS and relaxed dropped shoulders, their waists cut off at the bottom frame edge. Main figure near right edge: plain oversized hoodie with hood UP, head turned three-quarters AWAY from camera so we see the back/side of the hood, matte flat CYAN silhouette. No hair is visible, no pointed ears, no spikes, no anime styling. Secondary smaller figure nearer center-right: plain low baseball cap, head lowered and turned away, simple loose bomber jacket, matte ACID LIME silhouette, hands in pockets. Quiet, aloof, believable understated street attitude. Solid monochrome materials, heads remain uninterrupted flat color, ZERO FACE OR FACIAL FEATURES. ABSOLUTELY NO JEWELRY: no necklace, no chain, no cross, no pendant, no neck decoration, no earrings, no badges, no visible clothing logos, no chest marks. The chest panels are completely blank. No armor, no giant angular collar, no futuristic outfit, no exaggerated spiky hair, no dramatic posing, no fists, no combat stance, no weapons, no full bodies, no visible legs or shoes. Figures angular and boxy like actual low-poly meshes, chunky shoulder/hood volume, simple believable anatomy. Keep strong shape separation and white architecture peeking around them. Simple pixel-ish hard edges and limited ink palette; no glossy surfaces, no soft gradients, no fog, no bloom, no photographic texture. Tiny black passenger plane overhead optional. No lettering, no game logo, no UI, no words anywhere. Composition must leave left black region genuinely empty for native menu and separate wordmark.
logo: Design an original standalone transparent videogame WORDMARK that reads exactly AFTERHOURS. ONE LINE, very wide compact block lettering, all uppercase. Visual identity for a rough 2000s low-poly black-and-white city / magenta-cyan street fighting game. Build it as a hard, heavy, condensed INDUSTRIAL STENCIL wordmark: straight geometric strokes, squared block forms, a few deliberate sharp diagonal cuts through letters like cuts in low-poly building silhouettes. Understated confident underground street / techno record-label identity rather than playful graffiti. Letter fill PURE WHITE, tiny hot MAGENTA offset slab or underline on lower edge, one restrained CYAN cut accent at the end. Crisp edges, flat solid ink, no shadows, no gradients, no bevels, no 3D metallic finish, no outlines around each letter. Keep all 10 letters clearly readable at small size. NO CROWN, NO STAR, NO LIGHTNING, NO GRAFFITI SPIKES, NO NECKLACE, no people, no faces, no extra text, no badge border or enclosing rectangle. Transparent background, crop composition reasonably close to wordmark with modest breathing room. Wide horizontal logo asset, roughly 4:1 ratio, center it.
logo_final: A clean final production logo artwork on a PERFECT SOLID PURE BLACK #000000 background. The word AFTERHOURS, spelled A F T E R H O U R S, exactly ten letters, ONE LINE. Very bold condensed squared industrial sans-serif stencil lettering, each letter distinctly separated by a clearly visible BLACK GAP, the counters of A, R, O and R open in black. Stylish underground street / low-poly urban game wordmark. Large clean WHITE letter fill, one narrow HOT MAGENTA underline along bottom with a small cyan terminal cut. Geometric sharp diagonally clipped corners, subtle forward slant only. This is a vector-like graphic mark, NOT a photograph of signage and NOT a physical print. Completely flat pure solid ink. Absolutely NO distressing, NO speckles, NO dust, NO grain, NO mottling, NO weathering, NO textures, NO glows, NO grey shading, NO metallic effects, NO drop shadows, NO thick outline, NO crown, NO spiky decoration, NO extra shapes above letters, NO extra writing. Keep the typography legible with strong letter separation, do not merge adjacent letters into a white block. Full word should occupy middle 85% of image width and roughly 35% of its height. Landscape canvas about3:1. Clean black outside logo, generously but evenly framed.
parts: Create a TRANSPARENT modular UI graphics sheet for a black/white low-poly city street videogame with hot magenta and cyan accents. Square sheet, exactly FOUR SEPARATE GRAPHIC ASSETS arranged in a strict 2x2 equal-cell grid, each asset stays comfortably inside its own quadrant, 15% transparent gutters within each quadrant. ZERO TEXT OR NUMERALS, no logos, no people, no faces, no jewelry. TOP LEFT: a wide horizontal strip of stark WHITE angular low-poly building rooflines, a few square windows as transparent holes, one thin crooked cable passing across; 2000s rough urban silhouette, flat solid ink. TOP RIGHT: a simple WHITE rectangular selection CORNER FRAME, all center entirely transparent, just four substantial right-angle corner brackets, with one small flat magenta diagonal tab. BOTTOM LEFT: a compact cluster of three flat diagonal magenta and cyan cut slashes, like chopped urban stencil registration marks, clean flat ink. BOTTOM RIGHT: three WHITE simple vertical speaker/equalizer bars with a small cyan slab, simple bold readable geometric icon, no surrounding circle. Every asset sharp edged, monochrome white with the specified magenta/cyan only. No gradient, no glow, no blur, no fake lighting, no distressed dust, no shadows, no thin gray noise. Crisp sparse shapes intended for a 640x360 game interface. Actual transparent background, not a checkerboard drawing.
